movelist.name: Mist
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Mist may activate it when having Combat Stages lowered by any effect; if they do, those Combat Stages are instead not lowered. Mist may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Aurora Beam
movelist.effect: Aurora Beam lowers the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

movelist.name: Rain Dance
movelist.effect: The weather becomes Rainy for 5 rounds. While Rainy, Water-Type Attacks gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls, and Fire-Type Attacks suffer a -5 Damage penalty.

movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: All foes within 3 meters are Suppressed for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.trigger: The user uses the Sprint Action during Combat
abilities.effect: The user gains +2 Speed Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Speed is raised 1 Combat Stage at the end of each of its turns. Speed Boost has no effect while out of combat.
